**Software Developer**  
  
**Caltech**

**Job Category:** Parttime Term  
**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Overtime Eligible  
**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  
  
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
We're hiring a software developer to help build and maintain MathDB.
  
  
https://mathdb.com/
  
  
MathDB is a large-scale community database of definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems in mathematics, tracking the latest breakthroughs, and providing a new platform for research and collaboration. Mathematical knowledge is growing at an extraordinary pace. New results, methods and questions are arriving faster than the literature can absorb them, making it increasingly difficult to keep track of what is known, what remains open and how developments fit together. We need a shared database that grows with the subject: a living resource that the mathematical community can continually expand, correct and refine. Much of mathematical knowledge is scattered across papers, books, lecture notes and informal conversations. We aim to bring this knowledge together in a knowledge graph, connecting definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems through implications, equivalences, examples and shared ideas. Making these relationships explicit can reveal connections that are otherwise easy to miss, help researchers navigate unfamiliar areas and accelerate the discovery of new mathematics. Formalization offers another way to make mathematical knowledge precise, reliable and reusable. We are integrating Lean formalizations and automatic proof verification into MathDB, connecting mathematical statements and their explanations with proofs that can be checked by a computer. Our goal is to make it easier to contribute formal proofs, inspect their assumptions and build on verified results, while keeping the relationship between a formal statement and its mathematical meaning clear.  
  
We're looking for someone who has experience building web apps and AI agents, and who can join our effort in building and maintaining web apps, mobile apps, backend servers, databases and Lean formalization pipelines for MathDB.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties**  

* Assist in the development and maintenance of interactive web and mobile applications for MathDB.
* Support the development and maintenance of backend servers for MathDB.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of MathDB's backend database infrastructure.
* Support the development and maintenance of Lean formalization pipelines for MathDB.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Experience developing interactive web and mobile applications.
* Strong attention to detail in application design, performance, responsiveness, visual presentation, and user interface/user experience (UI/UX).
* Ability to work independently, adapt quickly, and incorporate feedback through an iterative development process.
* Experience with version control, software testing, and software engineering best practices.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience developing and delivering polished, production-ready software products beyond the prototype stage.
* Familiarity with cloud computing, containerization, and orchestration technologies.
* Strong interest in mathematical research.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with users and colleagues.
* Familiarity with Lean formalization.

  
**Required Documents**  

* Resume.

  
  
  
**To be considered for this position please visit our web site and apply on line at the following link:** **https://hr.caltech.edu/work/job\_openings**  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.description:
At Gardens Interactive, we're building games centered on connection, collective adventure, and emergent stories. We believe the spirit with which we build games is reflected in the experiences our players have. The way we collaborate, solve problems, navigate uncertainty, and care for one another ultimately shapes the worlds we create. We're creating magical, shared experiences that bring players together and we know those experiences come from teams that are curious, resilient, ambitious, and deeply committed to one another.

We're a fully remote studio that embraces collaboration, thoughtful iteration, and the courage to explore new ideas. If you're excited by ambiguity, enjoy solving difficult problems with kind, talented teammates, and want to help build worlds where friendships flourish, we'd love to meet you.

As a Gameplay Tools Engineer, you will create custom Unreal Engine tools that support teams across the studio. You will partner with stakeholders to understand the unique needs of their iteration workflows and author bespoke tools using C++ within the Unreal editor and in-game environments that will accelerate those pipelines. You will be a force-multipler for the team, enabling rapid exploration of new features and comprehensive analysis of and decision-making regarding the breadth of content that powers the emergent interactions of our games.

**A Day in the Life:**
======================

* Craft tools that support other disciplines (including art, audio, design) in efficient content creation, iteration and analysis.
* Work with individual developers to build features that can reduce manual effort and accelerate workflows.
* Playtest regularly with the team to understand the creative spaces our games are operating within in order to better support the team.

**What You’ll Do:**
===================

* Own the technical architecture and implementation of multiple tools and supporting systems across the game, partnering closely with stakeholders and the production team to improve iteration throughput.
* Collaborate closely with audio, VFX and design stakeholders to understand the needs of their development pipelines and proactively create solutions that will allow content production at scale.
* Act as a technical bridge between gameplay and backend engineering teams to aid in the development of analysis and diagnostics systems across all aspects of our games.
* Contribute to the stability of the game by proactively assisting in the identification and triage of issues in game systems, collaborating on solutions, and reducing friction in the development process.

**What You’ll Bring:**
======================

* 3+ years of experience building game tools across one or more projects.
* Experience building customized tools via the Unreal editor’s extension mechanisms.
* Familiarity with Wwise or similar audio middleware.
* Experience working closely with VFX systems and artists.
* Clear communication, strong collaboration, and the judgment to work independently, recognize constraints, and seek support when needed.

**Nice to Haves:**
==================

* Previous experience on shipped multiplayer titles using Unreal Engine.
* Prior experience owning the decision-making and implementations of significant portions of the tools ecosystem of a game or engine.
* Experience profiling and optimizing gameplay, engine or infrastructure systems for large-scale content.

**The Team:**
=============

* You will report to the Lead Gameplay engineer.
* You will join a team of gameplay engineers who work closely with other disciplines to champion the values that our games are centered on.

**How We Work**

We believe great games are built by people who care deeply about both the work and one another. Our values guide how we collaborate, solve problems, make decisions, and grow together. They're practical behaviors, not slogans, and they're part of how we hire, give feedback, and support one another every day.

We're looking for teammates who are excited to:

* Stay curious and ask thoughtful questions.
* Adapt when plans change.
* Exercise good judgment rather than chase perfection.
* Care for the success of the whole team, not just their own work.
* Pursue ambitious goals while remaining humble enough to keep learning.
* Commit fully to the shared adventure we're building together.

**You'll Thrive Here If...**

* You enjoy asking questions before jumping to conclusions.
* You adapt comfortably when priorities evolve.
* You balance ambition with pragmatism.
* You communicate thoughtfully and seek feedback.
* You care about helping your teammates succeed.
* You embrace uncertainty as part of creating something new.

**Please Note:** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. Gardens cannot assist with work authorizations or work visas. Applicants must also be willing to work within North American time zones (EST–PST).

**Our Interview Process**

(all interviews are 1 hour video calls on Google Meet unless otherwise noted)

* Step 1: People Operations Introduction
* Step 2: Hiring Manager Interview
* Step 3: Panel Interview (3 - 1 Hour Sections)
* Step 4: Gardeners Debrief
* Step 5: Offer

**Life at Gardens**

Gardens is a fully distributed game studio founded by creators behind titles including Journey, What Remains of Edith Finch, Blaseball, Dustforce, Ashen, Guild Wars 2, Baldur’s Gate 3, and more.

We're developing our flagship project: a multiplayer fantasy adventure inspired by the friendships, discoveries, and unforgettable stories that emerge when people explore together.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with diverse experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and ways of thinking. Every Gardener helps shape not only what we build, but how we build it.

Each of us arrives by a different path, bringing unique experiences, perspectives, and ways of seeing the world. That range is part of what makes our games and our studio better than any one of us

Manufacturers, distributors and other operations heavy businesses run inventory, production, sales orders, purchasing and warehousing on Sutton, and many also run custom apps we build with them in days, not months. Those apps are the reason customers love us.

We are a small team with big ownership, and we move fast: the distance between a customer's problem and something live in their hands is measured in days.

**The role**

We are hiring a full stack engineer who can build and run almost anything. You will work directly with our Founding Engineer and our founders.

There are no separate front end, back end or lead roles here. We are a flat group of strong generalists, and everyone owns what they build, from the first line of code to production. * Ship features end to end across a Node.js and GraphQL API, Postgres and a React front end, with AI assisted coding as a daily habit

* Build resilient integrations with accounting and commerce systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite and Shopify, with retries, idempotency and an alert when a sync stops

MathDB is a large-scale community database of definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems in mathematics, tracking the latest breakthroughs, and providing a new platform for research and collaboration. Mathematical knowledge is growing at an extraordinary pace. New results, methods and questions are arriving faster than the literature can absorb them, making it increasingly difficult to keep track of what is known, what remains open and how developments fit together. We need a shared database that grows with the subject: a living resource that the mathematical community can continually expand, correct and refine. Much of mathematical knowledge is scattered across papers, books, lecture notes and informal conversations. We aim to bring this knowledge together in a knowledge graph, connecting definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems through implications, equivalences, examples and shared ideas. Making these relationships explicit can reveal connections that are otherwise easy to miss, help researchers navigate unfamiliar areas and accelerate the discovery of new mathematics. Formalization offers another way to make mathematical knowledge precise, reliable and reusable. We are integrating Lean formalizations and automatic proof verification into MathDB, connecting mathematical statements and their explanations with proofs that can be checked by a computer. Our goal is to make it easier to contribute formal proofs, inspect their assumptions and build on verified results, while keeping the relationship between a formal statement and its mathematical meaning clear.
